paragraphs.text: Karsus is a plane first seen on the Worldwake Gateway card plane card Mirrored Depths . This depicts a large cave filled with giant crystals, reflecting various humans that seem to be involved in a fight.

Karsus is populated by humans, Viashino , and a unique form of Elementals which are made from the crystals that seemingly form the plane. During the New Phyrexian Invasion , these crystal elementals formed colossi which fought the New Phyrexian warriors.
The refractional properties of Karsus's crystals hurt both invading creatures and planeswalkers .
